tools.name: joyloyalty_whoami
tools.description: Return safe information about the connected Shopify shop (name, plan, currency, timezone). A good first call. GET /rest_api/v2/whoami.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_shop_settings
tools.description: Return the loyalty shop settings (program switches and widget options). GET /rest_api/v2/shop/settings.

tools.name: joyloyalty_list_customers
tools.description: List loyalty customers with points, tier and order counts. Paginate with after/before. GET /rest_api/v2/customers.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_customer
tools.description: Get one loyalty customer by Joy customer id: points, tier and activity. GET /rest_api/v2/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_customer_by_shopify_id
tools.description: Get one loyalty customer by their Shopify customer id. GET /rest_api/v2/customers/external/{shopifyCustomerId}.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_customer_points_earned
tools.description: Return the points one customer has earned in total. GET /rest_api/v2/customers/{customerId}/points/earned.

tools.name: joyloyalty_list_transactions
tools.description: List points transactions (earn, spend, manual adjustments) newest first by default. Paginate with after/before. GET /rest_api/v2/transactions.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_transaction
tools.description: Get one points transaction by id. GET /rest_api/v2/transactions/{transactionId}.

tools.name: joyloyalty_award_points
tools.description: WRITE: add points to a customer's balance (manual award). Changes live loyalty data and is not safe to repeat. POST /rest_api/v2/transactions/points/award.

tools.name: joyloyalty_deduct_points
tools.description: WRITE: remove points from a customer's balance. Changes live loyalty data and is not safe to repeat. POST /rest_api/v2/transactions/points/deduct.

tools.name: joyloyalty_list_earning_programs
tools.description: List earning programs (how customers earn points), with status and rules. GET /rest_api/v2/programs/earning.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_program
tools.description: Get one earning or redemption program by id. GET /rest_api/v2/programs/{programId}.

tools.name: joyloyalty_list_redemption_programs
tools.description: List redemption programs (how customers spend points on rewards). GET /rest_api/v2/programs/redemption.

tools.name: joyloyalty_list_rewards
tools.description: List customer rewards and their coupon codes, with status. Paginate with after/before. GET /rest_api/v2/rewards.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_reward
tools.description: Get one customer reward (coupon) by id. GET /rest_api/v2/rewards/{rewardId}.

tools.name: joyloyalty_refund_coupon
tools.description: WRITE: refund a redeemed reward coupon so the customer gets their points back. Changes live loyalty data. POST /rest_api/v2/rewards/coupons/refund.

tools.name: joyloyalty_list_tiers
tools.description: List VIP tiers with point targets and member counts. GET /rest_api/v2/tiers.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_tier
tools.description: Get one VIP tier by id, with its rewards. GET /rest_api/v2/tiers/{tierId}.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_referral_analytics
tools.description: Return referral program totals for the shop. GET /rest_api/v2/referrals/analytics.

tools.name: joyloyalty_get_customer_referral_summary
tools.description: Return one customer's referral totals (referrals made and rewards earned). GET /rest_api/v2/referrals/customers/{customerId}/summary.
